subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When live FR-6 persists one schema-valid completed aggregate for an exact proposal and revision, impl-review's host-side persistence adapter, acting on behalf of the reviewer program, shall be the sole performer of the medium-appropriate proposal write: one marker-block comment on GitHub or one typed decision record on Carina, carrying the human rendering and machine payload and surviving the session.
rationale: publication remains owned by impl-review while reviewer execution contexts and the invoking host keep separate responsibilities; FR-6 stays live for every frozen dependent
fit_criterion: both-media fixtures show FR-6 reaches the proposal only through the impl-review-owned adapter; no reviewer execution context or implement-now component contains a proposal publisher; the persisted rendering and payload round-trip byte-faithfully with the exact proposal and reviewed revision
